# Driver: argument parsing, help text, error reporting, and the subcommands.
# The version header is generated by the top-level CMakeLists
# (cmake/version.h.in) and reaches this target through minc_target_configure().
minc_add_library(minc_driver
  SOURCES
    cli.cc
    help_text.cc
    error_report.cc
    input_source.cc
    lex_command.cc
    parse_command.cc
    pp_command.cc
  DEPS minc_support minc_lex minc_lex_report minc_syntax minc_parse_report minc_pp
       minc_pp_report minc_pp_parse
)

minc_add_executable(mincc SOURCES main.cc DEPS minc_driver)
